settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery across India takes 4–7 business days, and metro cities are usually a little faster.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — shipping is free on all orders within India, with no minimum spend.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Right now we ship within India only. International shipping is on the way — join our newsletter to be the first to know.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you’ll receive a tracking link by email and SMS. You can also use the Track Order link in the menu or your account page.

settings.question: What is your return and exchange policy?
settings.answer: We offer 7-day size exchanges from the date of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and have their original tags intact.

settings.question: How do I request an exchange?
settings.answer: Email us with your order number and the size you’d like, and we’ll guide you through the quick exchange process.

settings.question: Are exchanges free?
settings.answer: Your first size exchange within the 7-day window is free.

settings.question: Can I get a refund?
settings.answer: We offer size exchanges and store credit rather than refunds, unless an item arrives defective or incorrect — in which case we’ll make it right.

settings.question: What sizes do you offer?
settings.answer: Every style in the capsule comes in inclusive sizing from S to XXL, designed to drape beautifully on every body.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Each product page includes a Size & Fit guide. If you’re between sizes, size down for a closer fit or up for extra ease.

settings.question: Do the dresses run true to size?
settings.answer: Yes — our pieces are true to size with a relaxed, feminine drape.

settings.question: What fabric are your pieces made from?
settings.answer: Premium, ultra-soft, breathable cotton — thoughtfully designed in India to look flawless and feel weightless.

settings.question: How do I care for my dress?
settings.answer: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, line dry, and warm iron if needed. Our cotton softens beautifully with every wash.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and popular wallets through our secure checkout.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Payments are processed through Shopify’s PCI-compliant, encrypted checkout — your details are always protected.

settings.question: Can I modify or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Contact us within 12 hours of placing your order and we’ll do our best to update or cancel it before it’s dispatched.
